dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what are you doing on Sunday? Let's get together!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ər juː ˈduːɪŋ ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ? ˈlɛts ˌɡɛt təˈɡɛðər!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'm working on Sunday. Are you free on Monday?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪm ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ. ər juː ˈfriː ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No. I'm going to the dentist on Monday. I have an appointment at three.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈdɛntɪst ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ. aɪ ˈhæv ən əˈpɔɪntmənt ət ˈθriː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What are you doing on Tuesday evening?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ər juː ˈduːɪŋ ɑːn ˈtuːzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm free! Some friends are going bowling. Come with us!
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈfriː! sʌm ˈfrɛndz ər ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈboʊlɪŋ. ˈkʌm wɪð ʌs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Bowling? I'm not very good at it.
dialogue.reading: ˈboʊlɪŋ? aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd ət ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's OK. We're meeting at the mall at six.
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. wɪr ˈmiːtɪŋ ət ðə ˈmɔːl ət ˈsɪks.
